body.x: HDBaseT Alliance(www.hdbaset.org), founded by LG Electronics, Samsung Electronics, Sony Pictures Entertainment and Valens to promote and standardize HDbaseT, introduced "DIY HDbaseT AV Home Project" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.HDBaseT is the ultimate digital connectivity solution for whole-home and commercial distribution of uncompressed HD multimedia content. The cornerstone of HDBaseT technology is 5Play, a feature set that converges uncompressed full HD digital video, audio, 100BaseT Ethernet, power over cable and various control signals through a single LAN cable.HDBaseT allows you to enjoy up to 4K video resolution, audio that passed through directly from the HDMI chipset, 100MB Ethernet enabling communication between TV, sound systems, computers, and other CE devices as well as access to any stored multimedia content, multiple control signals for Consumer Electronic Controls(CEC), Recommended Standard(RS)-232, USB, and infrared(IR). Up to 100W of DC power can be delivered over the same CAT5e/6 in a simple LAN cable. It replaces multiple cables and connectors in the home entertainment and business environment.Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot.
